approval_ref: The active goal requires lightweight, local and verifiable page selection before advanced-model reasoning, and the fixed 15-question preview exposed identifier-routing misses without making provider calls.
notes: Extract the bare value from explicit Sheet, Drawing, Section, Paragraph, RFI and Submittal labels; do not classify nonnumeric phrases such as sheet counts as identifiers.
Make an exact parser-locator identifier match outrank ordinary source-text mentions without choosing document precedence.
Cap each ordinary query term's source-text contribution per page so fragment density cannot inflate ranking.
Keep six-page and 48 KB bounds, exact source text, deterministic output, no Canonical graph, no embeddings and no model call.
Validate first against synthetic fixtures and then against the fixed 15-question preview using only page identities and counts; do not output source text.
Validated selector v2 against the fixed 15-question identity gate: 14/15 expected source pages selected versus 10/15 for v1, with no regression and zero provider calls.
Full validation passed: 1,494 Python tests, 24 localization tests, 11 deployment tests, 147 synchronized requirements, 21 schemas and a 599-file bundle manifest.
title: Prioritize explicit identifiers in Reference page selection
objective: Route explicit engineering identifiers to their parser-locator page before ordinary text matches, prevent dense fragmented pages from winning through repeated generic words, and improve the fixed 15-question zero-call expected-page gate without adding semantic preprocessing.
